acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: At Sullivan High School in Chicago, being able to communicate is key.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: A state senator tries persuading his own constituents, from his own party, that the 2020 election was not stolen.
acts.title: Until The Cows Come Home

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Elna Baker’s mom doles out some very harsh feedback for her daughter, which goes unnoticed for ten years.
acts.title: How I Met My Mother

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Literally, Amelia Bedelia works from home.
acts.title: Amelia Bedelia Works From Home

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: For more than fifty years, Jeanne Darst’s dad neglected to tell his entire family about their entire family.
acts.title: The Importance of Meeting Earnest
